chars.GROOM: a young Moroccan man, 25, short black curly hair, light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.BRIDE: a young Moroccan woman, 24, wearing a dusty pink hijab and a long cream cardigan over a white blouse
chars.FRIEND: a young Moroccan man with a buzz cut, wearing a green tracksuit with white side stripes
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother in her 50s, wearing a navy blue djellaba and a white headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Late evening in a Moroccan family salon with long banquette sofas: GROOM and BRIDE sit facing each other, he leans forward with a serious, determined face, gesturing with both hands as if saying 'we have to get married', she looks at him surprised and shy. Both faces clearly visible, centred.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small neighbourhood laundry shop in Casablanca with washing machines and folded clothes on shelves: GROOM stands proudly behind the counter with arms spread, FRIEND pats his shoulder grinning. Faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room in daylight: MOM holds BRIDE's hands warmly and smiles at her approvingly, BRIDE smiles politely, a tray of mint tea on the low table. Faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Two Moroccan families gathered around a low table with mint tea and pastries for a marriage proposal: GROOM sits nervously in the middle, MOM beside him nods happily and raises her hand as if agreeing. Warm light, faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A joyful Moroccan wedding night: GROOM in a white djellaba and red fez and BRIDE in an embroidered green and gold caftan with a matching headscarf sit together on a decorated wedding seat, guests clapping softly in the blurred background. Faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside the small laundry shop: BRIDE happily folds shirts at the counter while GROOM carries a basket of clean clothes and laughs with her. Faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A cosy small bedroom in a Moroccan family house with a window and patterned blanket: GROOM and BRIDE sit on the bed drinking tea and chatting happily, relaxed. Faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Family dinner on a low round table with a tajine: GROOM and BRIDE laugh together while MOM serves bread and smiles at them. Faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Morning on a Moroccan city street: BRIDE stands at a bus stop, GROOM pulls up in a small white car, leans over and opens the passenger door for her with a smile, she smiles back. Faces visible, centred.
